test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a function of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Banker to the public**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) acts as the central bank of the country, managing the monetary policy of the Indian rupee.
 
• RBI serves as the banker to the government, managing the banking needs of both the central and state governments.
 
• It is responsible for issuing the currency notes in India and ensuring their circulation within the economy.
 
• The RBI acts as the lender of last resort, providing financial assistance to banks during times of financial distress.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Banker to the Government:**

 
 
• RBI handles the banking transactions of the central and state governments, including their receipts and payments.
 
• It also manages the government’s public debt and issues new loans on behalf of the government.
 
 
 
• **Bank of Currency Issue:**
 
 
• RBI has the sole authority to issue currency notes in India, ensuring the supply of clean and genuine notes.
 
• This role involves designing, printing, and circulating the currency as well as managing its withdrawal and destruction.
 
 
 
• **Lender of the Last Resort:**
 
 
• In times of financial crisis, RBI provides emergency funding to banks facing severe liquidity shortages.
 
• This support helps to maintain stability in the banking system and prevents bank failures.
 
 
 
• **Banker to the Public:**
 
 
• This is not a function of the RBI as it does not directly interact with the general public for their day-to-day banking needs.
 
• Commercial banks serve this role by providing various banking services to individuals and businesses.
